description: The one Tier 0 path list (Owner only). Read by scripts/check-tier0.mjs (TIER0), @fw/policy (CORE_TIER0_PATHS, so the daemon's TIER0_PATHS) and @fw/ledger (ALWAYS_FORBIDDEN in work orders). AGENTS.md rule 3, CODEOWNERS and contracts-core/core-policy.yaml trust_tier_paths.tier0.paths must agree; scripts/check-bootstrap.mjs and packages/policy/test/tier0.test.ts fail on drift. Forms: a trailing / is the whole directory, * matches within one path segment, **/ matches any directory depth; matching ignores case.
